scripts.title: AUTO MATH
scripts.script:
local path = workspace.Map.Functional.Screen.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.MainGameContainer.MainTxtContainer.QuestionText
path.RichText = true
local lastQuestion = ""

while true do
    local currentText = path.Text

    if currentText ~= lastQuestion and not currentText:match("<font") then
        local expression = currentText
            :gsub("=", "")
            :gsub("%s+", "")
            :gsub("x", "*")

        local func = loadstring("return " .. expression)
        if func then
            local success, result = pcall(func)
            if success then
                local coloredResult = string.format('<font color="#34c3eb">%s</font>', result)
                path.Text = currentText .. " " .. coloredResult
                lastQuestion = path.Text
            end
        end
    end
    wait(0.2)
end

end

this script gives you ability to replace every single lms [for example, A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN), or Through Patches of Violet] to custom .mp3 file.

[HOW-TO CUSTOM LMS]
1. download any song that you want to have as lms
example, Eternal Hope, Eternal Fight as A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN)
2. put the .mp3 file to the Workspace folder of your executor
3. rename the .mp3 to original lms theme (in this example, A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN))
4. in result, you should have "A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN).mp3"
5. run the script
